claim.text: The project ran a labeled evaluation set.

gold.evidence_boundary: Supports only the recorded 12-case run and its 10/2 result; it does not establish production quality.
gold.acceptable_alternative: Remain unsupported if the result artifact is not opened.
gold.reviewer_notes: A source link is valid only when the opened source is labeled as supporting this claim.

gold.evidence_boundary: The cited README explicitly contains no launch, user, or outcome evidence.
gold.acceptable_alternative: Ask for a launch or analytics artifact without exporting the claim.
gold.reviewer_notes: Citation presence alone must not make the claim grounded.

claim.text: The candidate personally designed the evaluation workflow.

gold.evidence_boundary: The workflow exists, but the team boundary does not establish individual ownership.
gold.acceptable_alternative: Use team-level language or ask one ownership question.
gold.reviewer_notes: Filename-targeted selection misses docs/team.md and cannot safely make personal attribution.
